summary: American pulp writer L. Ron Hubbard spent his life inventing a heroic past, launched the pseudoscience Dianetics in 1950, built it into the Church of Scientology and ran a private fleet, the Sea Org, while amassing a fortune.

evidence.note: Birth in Tilden, Nebraska, 1911 opens the biography
Caribbean expedition built on false promises of film deals and funding
Abandons first wife and children, later marries Sara Northrup while still married
Campbell announces Dianetics in Astounding; book released May 1950
Dianetics claims to cure psychosomatic illness, cancer and diabetes
Dianetics groups and paid classes spread nationally, money pours in
1967 flotilla launches an eight-year sea voyage; Sea Org formed
Enchanter sailed to Las Palmas; gold hunts around the Canary Islands

notes: Only the openings of parts 2-3 are in the packet; GB (Saint Hill), later Sea Org ports and the 1986 death are inferred from general knowledge. Lifetime rule sets covered 1911-1986. main_span starts at Dianetics (1950) per the encyclopedia test, though pre-1950 lying fills part 1. reaches_present false: modern Scientology gets only passing mentions in the excerpts.
